coverageNotes: Measures one representative finite mixed-scalar set; other literal fields and the nested feature object remain coding coverage.

questions.context: Using Convex SDK 1.44.0, the required `enabled` field may be the number `0`, the number `1`, or the boolean `false`. No other value is allowed. `v` is imported from `convex/values`.
questions.question: Which validator accepts exactly those values?

options.rationale: The broad number validator also accepts 2 and other numbers.
Each allowed scalar is represented by its own literal validator.
The broad boolean validator also accepts true.
The string "false" differs from the required boolean false.
